d: Get deep sleep and enjoy a full night of rest with rain noise and thunder sounds. The heavy rain falls into the clay jars full of water, creating a satisfying splash that eases the mind. Paired with rumbling thunder, this ambience will make you feel truly relaxed. Plenty of people have trouble falling asleep for a variety of reasons. That is why they play rain sounds to sleep to! The relaxing rain noise for sleep is just what tireless minds need to get some rest. Give it a try next time you are laying in bed wide awake, and let the thunder and rain sound wash away your worries!
